findings.detail: Prowler helper compared tcp to native numeric 6 and accepted invalid port intervals; normalize documented names/numbers, validate TCP/UDP ranges and independent ICMP type/code, CIDR syntax/family. Root owns metadata materialization.
Ordered world TCP22 could PASS malformed protocol/action or reversed/out-of-range intervals. Native rule legality now validated before non-match; independent families and ordered semantics preserved.
Individual-entry remote-admin callback now validates native entries using the same pure helper; retains intentional lack of rule precedence.
_turbot protocol-filter variant now normalizes documented numeric6/17; port-only literal variants are intentionally not protocol-filtered.
